messages:
Nina H: Heads-up — we need a short thread to decide buy vs lease for Q3 hosted capacity. Forecast says ~18% traffic bump in July-August (api tokens) and spike in Nov.
Samir: Can you paste the forecast numbers? rough GPU-hours and tail-latency targets?
Nina H: Rough: baseline 24k GPU-hours/mo -> projected 28.5k in Jul-Aug, peak 34k in Nov. Target p50 < 120ms, p95 < 320ms for gen models.
Jorge: Important to know mix: heavy chat vs embeddings changes seq lengths. Chat sessions drive KV cache pressure; embeddings are short but many concurrent requests. Our current fleet is 50% A100-80GB, 30% H100, 20% older A40s.
Lia: Lease vendor quoted lead times: 6–8 weeks for A100 refurbished, 12–20 weeks for new H100. Price delta huge for H100 right now.
Samir: Cost math I've been running: leasing 100 H100-equivalent GPU-months at market rates ~ $X0k/month vs buying amortized ~ $Yk/month over 36mo + ops. Lease gives flexibility for Nov surge but less unit cost efficiency.
Nina H: Also factor Dedicated customers: reserved capacity must be guaranteed. Hosted can degrade to cheaper models but we need SLA-backed fallback.
procure-bot: vendor RFPs updated: vendor-a (12mo lease), vendor-b (buy & deploy service), vendor-c (flex lease with burst). Docs: https://redwood.internal/capacity/rfps
Jorge: Operational risk: bringing new hardware adds driver/kernel churn and we have two infra teams to onboard (runtime + infra). If timeline tight, prefer short leases to cover surge while we validate new hardware.
Ops-oncall: Note: last time we added refurbished fleet we saw a 3% increase in node flakiness for 2 weeks — extra SRE time.
Lia: Regional constraint: APAC colo has limited H100 slots; lead times double. If APAC tails spike, we should plan regional bursting to eu/us rather than force new APAC racks.
Samir: Proposal A: Buy 30 H100-equivalent now (long-term cost savings), run canary + staggered onboarding, assume 8 week procurement. Proposal B: 6-mo leases to cover Jul-Nov surges and re-evaluate after Q4.
Nina H: Can we hybridize? Buy 15, lease 20 for seasonal buffer. That keeps cost down and reduces procurement risk.
Jorge: Hybrid looks sensible. Need exact numbers: which instance types map to our kernel optimizations. Also check licensing/driver compatibility for quantized kernels.
Samir: I ran quick calc in sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/capacity-q3. Hybrid (15 buy, 20 lease) cuts peak expected spend by ~12% vs all-lease and reduces ops churn vs all-buy.
Lia: What about resale risk and warranty? Vendors offering buy come with 3yr support + trade-in option; refurbished buys carry shorter warranty.
Procure-bot: Vendor quotes summary attached in the shared doc. Key points: vendor-a (new H100) 20wk lead, vendor-b (refurb A100) 6wk, vendor-c (flex lease) immediate but premium.
Ops-oncall: Network note — adding 35% more GPUs increases east-west bandwidth needs; we need to prebook additional spine ports in colo or expect queueing impacting p95.
Jorge: Good catch. If we add physical racks, budget for additional 100Gbps ports and cross-rack trunking config. Lia, can you scope port costs per colo?
Lia: On it. Preliminary: $7k/month per 100Gbps per site in us-east, apac ~ $10k. Will add to the sheet.
Samir: Quick ask: can we simulate the buffer strategy (cache hit improvements + batching changes) to show effective GPU-hour reduction? Small config changes might cut peak GPU-hours by 8–10%.
Nina H: Yes — infra-ml to run sim. Jorge, can you schedule a 1hr run this week?
Jorge: Scheduling for Wed 11am. Will run traffic replay with improved batching and optimized prefix caching.
Procure-bot: Reminder: Financial needs PO by May 20th for any purchases to align with Q3 spend window.
Nina H: Decision roadmap: run sim Wed -> Lia posts final colo port cost by Thu -> Samir updates cost comparisons -> sync Fri 10am for final buy/lease recommendation. If we miss PO date, we default to leases.
Samir: Ack. I'll prepare the amortization scenarios (24/36/48mo) and lease options with early-terminate costs.
Lia: Flagging a minor blocker: vendor-c requires a minimum 40 unit lease to get flex pricing. Might push us to change counts.
Jorge: If we lease with vendor-c for burst only, negotiate smaller min with commit to bring some units on our racks later.
Nina H: Thanks team. Quick vote: Hybrid (buy 15, lease ~20) :thumbsup:, All-lease :thumbsdown:, All-buy :neutral_face:.
Samir: :thumbsup:
Jorge: :thumbsup:
Lia: :thumbsup: (pending port costs)
Ops-oncall: :thumbsup: (ops support but increased oncall)
procure-bot: Recorded decision intent: hybrid — follow-up task created: https://redwood.internal/tasks/CI-4721
Nina H: OK locking roadmap. Follow-ups: procurement to get formal quotes, infra to prep canary plan, SRE to estimate oncall impact. I'll send calendar invite for Fri sync.
Samir: will attach cost slides before the sync.
Jorge: will post sim results after the run.
Lia: will upload port cost details.
Nina H: Thanks — good progress.
